description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This one lets Infinite Canvas, formerly Infinite Conversations, hold as many canvases as you like, each opened from a card list. Codex moves to its 2.0.1 adapter with GPT-6.1 Sol as its new default model, and an agent's settings now offer its newest release when it's ahead of the version codeg recommends.
Alongside that: a customized Codex model list picks up new official models on its own, and a to-do's base branch shows HEAD and the branch it's on.
New
- Infinite Canvas, formerly Infinite Conversations, holds as many canvases as you like — it opens on a card list that previews each canvas and lets you search, create, edit (name, description, color) or delete them, and the board you already had carries over as "Untitled canvas".
- Codex gets GPT-6.1 Sol, its new default model — it arrives with Codex CLI 0.159.2 and heads the composer's model picker.
- An agent offers its newest release when it's ahead of the one codeg recommends — its Version Status in Settings → Agents shows an amber "Upgrade to unreviewed latest X" button that asks you to confirm before installing, and now labels the recommended version "Recommended" instead of "Remote".
Improved
- Updated bundled agents: Codex ACP 2.0.1 (Codex CLI 0.159.2).
- A customized Codex model list picks up new official models when Codex is installed or upgraded, in Codex's own order, instead of only after you refresh the list and save it again.
- A to-do's Base branch reads "HEAD" beside the branch the project folder is on when you leave it at the default, instead of a grey "Current branch".
Note
- The "Adapter version" setting is gone — an agent you had set to "Latest (unreviewed)" goes back to installing and upgrading to the recommended version, so use "Upgrade to unreviewed latest" when you want the newest one.
- Codex conversations that never had a model picked now run on GPT-6.1 Sol — if the model provider you use for Codex doesn't serve it yet, pick a model in the composer or fill in the provider's Model field.
